import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem,rdDistGeom
from rdkit import DistanceGeometry
s='CC(C)c1cccc(C(C)C)c1N1P(c2ccccc2)(c2ccccc2)->[Rh]<-[Cl]->[Rh][Ge]1(Cl)Cl.C1=CCCC=CCC1.C1=CCCC=CCC1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
for a in m.GetAtoms(): print(a.GetIdx(), a.GetSymbol(), a.GetNumImplicitHs(),a.GetHybridization(), a.GetNumRadicalElectrons())
rw=Chem.RWMol(m)
for rh, carbons in [(26,[32,33,36,37]),(28,[40,41,44,45])]:
 for c in carbons: rw.AddBond(c,rh,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m);m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atomcount',m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# bond and distance constraints
cons=[(12,13,1.74),(12,29,1.86),(13,26,2.27),(26,27,2.44),(27,28,2.44),(28,29,2.43),(29,30,2.20),(29,31,2.20)]
for rh, carbons in [(26,[32,33,36,37]),(28,[40,41,44,45])]:
 for c in carbons: cons.append((rh,c,2.17))
b=rdDistGeom.GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix(m)
for i,j,d in cons:
 i,j=sorted((i,j));b[i,j]=d+.03;b[j,i]=d-.03
print('smoothing',DistanceGeometry.DoTriangleSmoothing(b))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=1445;p.numThreads=4;p.SetBoundsMat(b);p.useRandomCoords=True;p.maxIterations=3000
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=8,params=p)
print('embedded',list(ids))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'initial.mol',confId=0)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'initial.xyz',confId=0)
import pickle
with open('build.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump((m,cons),f)
PY
